serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The Gen3 Data Ecosystems Platform system has been determined to have a security categorization of Moderate (M). The Gen3 Data Ecosystems Platform (Gen3) is an open-source multi-tenant Software as a Service (SaaS) platform for developing, configuring, and operating cloud-based data commons, data ecosystems (also known as data meshes), and workspaces for managing, analyzing, and sharing both open access and controlled access data.
